mechanism: The recycler awaits render and render-candidate callbacks after selecting the actual generation. Episode state construction and tokenizer measurement now occur inside that exact callback; no future generation is precomputed.
verified: Synchronous render callers remain compatible with the awaitable recycler seam.
No-recycle episodes make zero state tokenizer measurements and contain zero state presentations.
The first recycled request makes exactly one state measurement and binds its presentation to the successful request digest.
A state-token overflow occurs only at the recycler-selected generation and blocks before that model dispatch.
Separate state-tokenizer endpoint failures retain their underlying transport code instead of being flattened to consumer-denied.
claim_ceiling: Offline exact-generation instrument validity only; no H13 outcome, transfer, or benchmark claim.
